description: This file defines the I18nController class, which integrates internationalization (i18n) functionality with a ReactiveController-based host, handling subscription management and update triggers.

classes.name: I18nController
classes.description: A ReactiveController that manages subscriptions to the i18n system and triggers host updates accordingly.

methods.name: hostConnected
methods.description: Sets up a subscription to the i18n service and requests host updates when language data changes.

methods.name: hostDisconnected
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the i18n service to prevent memory leaks when the host disconnects.
